title: Senior Engineering Manager (AI Search & Retrieval)
jobDescription:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.
  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.
And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

About the Team: AI Search & Retrieval

The AI Search & Retrieval team owns our core search platform, serving hundreds of millions of queries per day across enterprise customers. We build and operate highly scalable, low-latency systems that combine traditional information retrieval with modern ML-driven ranking, semantic understanding, and large-scale data processing—all in production at scale.

This team sits at the intersection of systems engineering, search relevance, and applied ML, with a direct impact on customer revenue and experience.

The Role

As a Senior Engineering Manager for AI Search & Retrieval, you will lead a high-performing team of engineers (including Senior Staff level talent) responsible for shaping the architecture and long-term evolution of our Search platform. You are a proven engineering leader who is passionate about mentoring technical talent, fostering a culture of psychological safety, and rallying a team to deliver on complex technical initiatives that directly contribute to business goals.

This role is ideal for someone who balances strong people leadership with deep technical empathy for Search domains, distributed systems, and modern AI/ML production systems.

What You’ll Do

Technical Leadership & Domain Strategy

  • Evolve Search Architecture: Champion the technical roadmap and long-term strategy for core Search infrastructure, spanning indexing, retrieval, ranking, query-time execution, and data processing.
  • Bridge Engineering & Applied Science: Partner closely with Applied Science and ML teams to productionize advanced ranking models, vector embeddings, and semantic retrieval techniques.
  • System Excellence at Scale: Ensure search systems meet strict latency, availability, and cost-efficiency SLAs under heavy, real-world enterprise traffic.
  • Modernize Data Pipelines: Direct the implementation of scalable data streaming and ingestion platforms to ensure search indexes are accurate, automated, and optimized.

Team and Project Management

  • Execute with Predictability: Collaborate closely with Product Management and cross-functional stakeholders to translate ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable technical roadmaps.
  • SDLC & Operational Health: Manage the full project lifecycle using structured development cycles. Set high expectations for code quality, rigorous design reviews, change management, and search evaluation metrics (including A/B testing).
  • Global Collaboration: Drive alignment and consensus across geographically distributed teams and time zones, proactively resolving dependencies and architectural conflicts.

People Leadership & Culture

  • Nurture High-Caliber Talent: Build, hire, and mentor a best-in-class search engineering team, fostering an inclusive culture of continuous learning, technical excellence, and high performance.
  • Coach Technical Leaders: Act as a manager and career coach to senior technical talent (including Staff/Senior Staff engineers), creating growth opportunities, defining clear career paths, and helping them maximize their impact as multipliers.

What You’ll Bring

Technical Depth & Experience

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record in backend infrastructure, distributed systems, and large-scale computing.
  • Strong domain expertise in Search or Information Retrieval systems, including understanding of search relevance, ranking, and catalog indexing.
  • Deep data ecosystem knowledge: Experience with big data processing or streaming technologies (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Flink, Solr, Lucene, or Elasticsearch).
  • Cloud Operations: 4+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating production systems within AWS, GCP, or another major cloud provider.
  • Language Proficiency: Strong foundations in core production languages, with Java and/or Python strongly preferred.

Leadership & Product Acumen

  • 4+ years of experience successfully leading, hiring, coaching, and developing high-performance engineering teams.
  • Strategic Vision: Ability to possess and articulate a strong product and architectural vision for AI-driven platforms, balancing precision, recall, latency, and operational costs.
  • Ambiguity to Execution: Proven ability to handle complex, high-volume production environments with excellent prioritization, time management, and a focus on measurable execution.
  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs to business stakeholders and advocate for engineering health.

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with vector search, embeddings, or semantic retrieval.
  • Familiarity with offline search evaluation frameworks and online A/B experimentation.
  • Experience in a high-growth, fast-paced SaaS, e-commerce search, or startup environment.

What Success Looks Like in the First 30/60/90 Days

First 30 Days: Immersion & Foundation

  • Cultural & Process Acumen: Achieve a deep understanding of our core company values, the development lifecycle, and quality/release processes.
  • Product Architecture Mastery: Develop a high-level comprehension of the AI Search & Retrieval architecture, its key components, and underlying data flows.
  • Team & Project Mapping: Establish trusted working relationships with all team engineers. Gain a clear handle on all in-flight search initiatives, priorities, and individual ownership.

First 60 Days: Ownership & Optimization

  • Deep Component Knowledge: Attain a thorough understanding of search relevance systems, upstream/downstream dependencies, and how the platform delivers customer business value.
  • Process Ownership: Fully own and optimize the team’s operating norms and processes (e.g., sprint planning, bug triage, query performance review, and on-call rotations).
  • Internal Network: Establish key, cross-functional working relationships with Product, Applied Science, and Engineering leaders outside the immediate team.

First 90 Days: Strategic Impact & Talent Development

  • Operational Credibility: Successfully shepherd a small feature, enhancement, or optimization through to production deployment, validating system and process knowledge.
  • Team & Quality Assessment: Develop a clear, objective insight into the team's technical strengths, weaknesses, and key skill or capacity gaps.
  • Strategic Improvement Plan: Collaborate with Product and Engineering leadership to propose concrete suggestions for improving search relevance, system latency, or team efficiency.
  • Talent Management Kick-off: Actively manage engineers' careers, establishing robust rapport and defining tailored growth opportunities for each team member.

More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

  • A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.
  • We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.
  • We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.

The Pulsar team builds platform and admin services that all Bloomreach SaaS products rely on. In your first year, you’ll develop features used by thousands of customers and deliver fast, consistent, and high-energy (but low-drama) product releases.

Examples of our services:

  • Central services to publish Model Context Protocol APIs for external AI agents
  • Multi-product customer provisioning and licensing orchestration
  • Integrated user management, authentication, and authorization
  • High-availability, centralized configuration management
  • Tools for new customer integration & product tuning

Why you’ll love your work

  • Technical Variety: Cloud-native services with diverse tech stacks offer learning and experimentation.
  • Impact: Our services are used by customers and teams across the company – engineers, product managers, services consultants, and even executives.
  • Autonomy: Senior engineers design, build, and deploy complete projects and are experts in our services.
  • Teamwork: Your teammates are also high performers and will support you with learning our systems, brainstorming & design review, and running high-reliability production deployments.

Your typical day

Your day begins with review of a teammate’s GitLab merge request. It has already been reviewed by Claude, but you’ll think deeply about the business problem, alternative solutions, and future needs. Then you spend a few undisturbed hours “in the flow,” working on changes to the user management APIs to support a UX improvement that a designer suggested yesterday. Soon, all your new unit tests are green. With a few keystrokes, you create a merge request, spin up a dev instance, and deploy your change. After some quick smoke tests, you send a link to a frontend engineer who is collaborating with our team.

After lunch, you join your team for a quick standup via Zoom to discuss current work and the plan for the next few days. A teammate offers to review your new code. It has some complex behavior, so you walk through it together and make a few improvements.

The frontend engineer confirms over Slack that your API changes provide what they need. You merge it, which automatically retests and deploys to a staging environment. The UI changes and a few more integration tests from the QA team will be merged in a day or two. Your improvement will be in production in a few weeks.

Next, you respond to a Slack request for advice on integrating with the authorization API. You draft a short tech design doc that links the API spec, code examples, and optimization tips. You discuss it on the team channel, and your manager forwards it to another team that’s also starting a new service.

Your day ends with a quick chat with a product manager about another idea….

  • Languages & Frameworks: Java / Spring, Python, Go – occasionally TypeScript, Angular, React
  • Data: Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka
  • Cloud: AWS & GCP (RDS, Redshift, Pub/Sub, BigTable, DataFlow, etc), Docker & Kubernetes (via EKS & GKE)
  • Tools: Jira, Gitlab CI/CD, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenSearch

Our expectations

  • Flexible intelligence: Stretch your technical skills in a distributed cloud environment, making changes across systems built with various tech stacks to meet challenging requirements.
  • Drive: Rapidly ship product improvements that affect thousands of users in a low-drama and high-trust way.
  • Security & Reliability: Balance risks and benefits of change with discipline and agility.
  • Communication: Organize technical work and maintain trust/respect across multiple teams, geographic regions, and departments.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Proactively share expertise, guide less experienced team members, and document work for long-term sustainability.

  • Developed backend services with Python using a variety of data systems (3+ years)
  • Understands web security principles (OWASP), Authentication, and Authorization practices
  • Designed APIs for a SaaS product
  • Operated services in production on public cloud infrastructure

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to:
    • Validate new features in pilot implementations.
    • Provide structured feedback from the field.
    • Review Product Requirements and technical designs where TC input is needed.

  • Education:
    • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Technical background:
    • JavaScript (browser and integration patterns), HTML, CSS.

    • 3+ years in a technical services, solutions engineering, implementation consulting, or similar role in a SaaS / e‑commerce / martech environment (P2 level).
    • Strong hands‑on experience with web technologies:
    • Solid understanding of e‑commerce platforms (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, commercetools, Adobe/Magento, SAP Commerce) and how they integrate with third‑party services.
    • Experience with search / recommendation / personalization technologies (e.g., Solr, Elasticsearch, SaaS product discovery platforms) is strongly preferred.
    • Comfortable working with logs, developer tools, and data to debug feed, tracking, and API issues.
    • We also welcome candidates from a business consulting background who have strong technical skills and are looking to move into a more technical consulting role; a strong consulting mindset is as important as deep technical expertise in this position.
  • Implementation & delivery skills:

    • Experience reading and interpreting technical specifications, data contracts, and tracking documents.
    • Familiarity with agile delivery practices and risk/issue management.
  • Communication & consulting:

    • Strong client‑facing presence, able to lead technical discussions, manage expectations, and push back constructively when necessary.
    • Proven consulting mindset: able to uncover underlying business objectives, challenge assumptions, and translate them into pragmatic technical solutions.
    • Comfort facilitating workshops, technical deep‑dives, and handover sessions with client and internal teams.

  • Knowledge of tag managers (e.g., Google Tag Manager, Tealium) and instrumentation of tracking across multi‑site setups.
  • Experience in retail, fashion, or multi‑brand commerce environments.
